text:
Emma Park: Hi folks! Super excited to join Redwood Inference today as a Product Designer. Im Emma (she/her), currently in Portland. I love sourdough, sketching interfaces, and spontaneous dog park runs. ✨
Noah Li: Welcome Emma!! :tada: If you're ever in SF, there's a great little coffee cart by the courtyard. Also, design critique on Thursdays if you want to pop in.
Priya Singh: Hey Emma  welcome! We do a quick "show & tell" every other Monday for new folks  bring snacks or a goofy prop. Also curious: favorite design tool?
Emma Park: Mostly Figma, but guilty pleasure is pen-and-paper for early ideation. Snacks: sourdough crisps? :bread:
welcome-bot: Welcome @Emma Park!  You've been added to #new-hires and the "Design Onboarding" doc: https://redwood.company/onboarding/design (automated)
Team Ops: Heads up: We'll mail you a starter desk plant and a welcome kit. Could you DM us your T-shirt size and preferred pronouns?
Emma Park: Sent a DM with size and pronouns. Also, allergic to kiwi  avoids the fruit tray.
Noah Li: Noted on kiwi. We'll save you from the fruit roulette. See you at the design critique on Thu 4pm PT if you can make it.
Priya Singh: Adding you to the "design-crit" calendar now. Welcome aboard  excited to work with you!
Emma Park: Thank you!!! Looking forward to meeting everyone.
